annotations.title: Show or hide your product's In Audit

description: Your product's place in our directory while its Audit runs (a verified claim): listed true shows it as In Audit, false keeps it private until it is Audited. The answer's directory says where it stands: audited, in_audit, hidden, lapsed or none. whoami shows each claim's directory.

listed.description: true: show it as In Audit; false: keep it private until it is Audited
